checks.sub: Six points, in writing, on every Paris lease.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: The lease must state the reference rent and cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. We run the check.

items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: A chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle; agent fees to tenants are capped by law. We open with a licensed partner.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month's rent unfurnished, two furnished, by law. Agents still ask for more, or months in advance. We don't let them.

items.title: Lease type
items.text: Unfurnished, furnished or bail mobilité: each sets notice, deposit and rights. We check which you're handed, and which charges are yours.

items.title: Proof of address
items.text: Bank, prefecture and school ask for it first. We make sure your lease serves as one from day one.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: Payslips, tax notice, a French guarantor — or Visale, the state guarantee, for many under 30 and new hires. We write the dossier so it passes.

truth.p: A tenancy that goes wrong costs us more than a lost fee — so we write down what we saw, before you sign.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Paris, the tenant-side desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency, opening with a licensed partner (carte professionnelle). Hired and paid by the tenant only.
Internationals relocating to Paris — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
VAT included, charged only when the desk opens. No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.

Today: your file, opened and kept ready. When the desk opens: French-format dossier in 24 hours, applications within the hour, attended viewings, rent cap and lease checked, proof of address from day one.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date, and we don't search on your behalf in France before the desk opens.

items.q: Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Paris yet?
items.a: Searching on a client's behalf is regulated in France: a chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle (loi Hoguet). We open with a licensed partner rather than work around the rule. Your file waits, ready; you hear from us the day the desk opens.

items.q: What can you do for me today?
items.a: Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Paris. The prices on this page are set; nothing is charged until the desk opens and the work starts.

items.q: Is my rent capped in Paris?
items.a: Paris applies the encadrement des loyers: the lease must state the reference rent, and the asking rent cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. An asking rent above the cap is leverage, not a given.

items.q: Do I need to be in Paris?
items.a: No. When the desk opens, a BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The lease is read and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the état des lieux.

items.q: What does an agent legally charge a tenant in France?
items.a: The fees a letting agent may charge a tenant are capped by law, per square metre. An agent you hire, who works only for you, is a different, licensed service. That is why we open with a licensed partner, and never take landlord money.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: It is used to answer you and to open your file, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.

band.p: One minute now — a reply the same working day.
